meta.defaultDescription: Xavier and Patrick, independent state-certified guides, take you rafting on the Durance river and canyoning near Embrun and Lake Serre-Ponçon, in the French Alps.

rafting.title: Ride the Durance rapids
rafting.subtitle: Join Xavier and Patrick for a run down the Durance river's rapids, between cliffs and forests in the French Alps. Real thrills, professional guiding.

canyoning.title: Dive into the canyons
canyoning.subtitle: Jumps, natural slides, abseils and waterfall pools: our mountain guides take you through the finest canyons around Embrun, safely and at your pace.

about.title: Xavier & Patrick, passionate whitewater guides
about.body: Activités Nature is run by two independent guides based in Baratier, on the shore of Lake Serre-Ponçon, right next to Embrun. Mountain guides and state-certified instructors, Xavier and Patrick share over 30 years of combined experience in rafting and canyoning across the Hautes-Alpes. Their goal: share their playground with groups, families and beginners, in a friendly and safe atmosphere.

activities.title: An adventure for every mood
activities.subtitle: From family-friendly rafting on the Durance to sportier canyons in the Écrins: our guides tailor every trip to your level.

rafting.title: Rafting on the Durance
rafting.description: Aboard a raft led by a state-certified guide, ride the Durance river's rapids through a spectacular setting of limestone cliffs and forests in the Hautes-Alpes. The descent adapts to the group's level and mood, from playful stretches to livelier rapids, with no prior experience required. A friendly, refreshing activity — perfect with friends, family, or for a stag or hen party.
highlights: Great for groups, families, stag/hen parties
A lively ride, real thrills guaranteed

canyoning.title: Canyoning in the Écrins
canyoning.description: Wading through the torrent, jumps, natural slides and short abseils: our guides pick the canyon that matches your level.

itineraries.name: Le Couleau
itineraries.description: A gentle aquatic hike: wading, small jumps, slides and caves. Perfect as a family.

itineraries.name: Canyon du Fournel
itineraries.description: In Argentière-la-Bessée, 40 minutes from Embrun: 2–7 metre jumps, a natural slide and a via ferrata section.
